# Habakkuk Chapter 2 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/HAB_002_page_001.jpg

---

**2:2** And-YHWH answered-me [vayyaaneni] and-said, "Write [ketov] the-vision [chazon] and-make-it-plain [u-va'er] on the-tablets [al-ha-luchot], so-that he-may-run [yarutz] who-reads-it [qore vo]."

**2:3** "For still [od] the-vision [chazon] [is] for-the-appointed-time [la-mo'ed]; and-it-pants [veyafe'ach] toward-the-end [la-qets] and-does-not lie [velo yekhazzev]. If it-tarries [im-yitmahemah], wait [chakkeh] for-it; for it-will-surely-come [ki vo yavo]; it-will-not delay [lo ye'acher]."

**2:4** "Behold, his-soul [nafsho] [is] puffed-up [uppelah]; it-is-not upright [lo yashrah] in-him. But-the-righteous [tsaddiq] by-his-faithfulness [be-emunato] will-live [yichyeh]."

**2:20** "But-YHWH [is] in-his-holy [qodsho] temple [heikhal]; be-silent [has] before-him [mi-panav], all the-earth [kol ha-arets]!"
